title: Fix three bugs in a Rust MathUtils module
description: Fix bugs in MathUtils: factorial returns 0 for n=0 (base case wrong), gcd returns b instead of a when b==0, is_perfect_square checks sqrt*sqrt == n+1 (off by one).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. factorial: change base case to `return 1` so factorial(0)==1 and all factorials are correct
2. gcd: change `return b` to `return a` so the Euclidean base case returns the actual GCD
3. is_perfect_square: change `n + 1` to `n` so perfect squares are detected correctly
All 4 test functions must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
